title: ERalpha anthraquinone molecular dynamics inputs and analysis data
description: Simulation inputs and derived analyses of anthraquinone recognition by estrogen receptor alpha. The dataset includes eleven thousand and twenty-two frame-level geometric measurements, reconstruction and verification scripts for the instantaneous bridging bound, equation-derived ensemble analyses, fingerprint-score checks, and hydroxyl-geometry figures and plotting sources. Simulation inputs cover 34 retained conventional runs, 45 umbrella windows (708 ns nominal) and 12 shared-bias AWH walkers (87.504 ns). Coordinate trajectories and proprietary software are excluded. Derived-data checks run without trajectories; reconstructing the measurements from original coordinates requires the saved trajectories. Local prediction files retain their original project timestamps; no external registration is claimed.
notes: The data license applies to the authors' new numerical data and records. Third-party force-field material, existing software and adapted code retain their original terms as detailed in LICENSE_SCOPE.md. This metadata file does not claim that a Zenodo record or DOI already exists.
